body:
## WARNING THERE IS 2 TYPES NORMAL AND MEGA:
The normal dark mode is what i user personally as its not to dark.
The mega dark mode is alot darker its more black then grey.

# WeirdRandomStuff's resource pack
This is basicly just a simple dark mode made by me im planning on improving it alot.

## Info
This pack has been tested on 1.21.x and 26.x.
As this pack is mostly gui it should work on most versions.
